sources.title: Owner-supplied Google Maps school reference
sources.note: Image #1: owner-supplied Google Maps overhead of the Annex on Fourth Street, inspected 2026-10-04. The owner explicitly instructed proceeding with this reference. The central lawn, eastern foliage and edge approaches guide a restrained fit to the complete mapped grounds and five standing classroom roofs. The imagery is rotated relative to north-up OSM; alignment and dimensions remain approximate. No Google reuse rights are asserted; the reference raster is not distributed.
